    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.boundaryLinear_rank_eq_of_source_iso (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y X' Y' A B : C} (p : X ⟶ Y) (p' : X' ⟶ Y') (q : A ⟶ B) (a : X ≅ X') (b : Y ≅ Y') (e : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom p' = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p b.hom) :
    Module.finrank k ↥(boundaryLinear k p q).range = Module.finrank k ↥(boundaryLinear k p' q).range

    Isomorphic source differentials give the same rank of the homotopy boundary.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.boundaryLinear_rank_eq_of_target_iso (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y X' Y' A B : C} (p : X ⟶ Y) (p' : X' ⟶ Y') (q : A ⟶ B) (a : X ≅ X') (b : Y ≅ Y') (e : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp a.hom p' = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p b.hom) :

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.boundaryLinear_add_smul (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_3, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {X Y A B : C} (p r : X ⟶ Y) (q s : A ⟶ B) (a : k) :
    boundaryLinear k (p + a • r) (q + a • s) = boundaryLinear k p q + a • boundaryLinear k r s
    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.boundaryLinear_scalarExtension (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_4, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (F : Type u_3) [Field F] [Algebra k F] {X Y A B : C} (p : X ⟶ Y) (q : A ⟶ B) :
    let G := ScalarCategory.of; have E := TensorProduct.prodRight k F F (X ⟶ A) (Y ⟶ B); boundaryLinear F (G.map p) (G.map q) ∘ₗ ↑E = LinearMap.baseChange F (boundaryLinear k p q)

    A boundary after extending its two differentials is the scalar extension of the original boundary under the product comparison.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.boundaryLinear_scalarExtension_surjective_iff (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_4, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (F : Type u_3) [Field F] [Algebra k F] {X Y A B : C} (p : X ⟶ Y) (q : A ⟶ B) :
    have G := ScalarCategory.of; Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear F (G.map p) (G.map q)) ↔ Function.Surjective ⇑(boundaryLinear k p q)

    Extension of the Hom spaces along a field extension preserves and reflects surjectivity of a boundary.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.boundaryLinear_scalarExtension_affine_range (k : Type u_1) [Field k] {C : Type u_2} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_4, u_2} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] (F : Type u_3) [Field F] [Algebra k F] {X Y A B : C} (p p' : X ⟶ Y) (q q' : A ⟶ B) (s : F) :
    let G := ScalarCategory.of; (boundaryLinear F (G.map p + s • G.map p') (G.map q + s • G.map q')).range = (LinearMap.baseChange F (boundaryLinear k p q) + s • LinearMap.baseChange F (boundaryLinear k p' q')).range

    The range of a boundary on an affine pair of differentials is the range of the corresponding affine pencil of linear maps on the extended Hom spaces.
